experiment.name: Repeated stratified cross-validation
experiment.metric_units: accuracy, precision_weighted, recall_weighted and f1_weighted are fractions in [0, 1] (not percentages); training_time_sec is seconds.
experiment.std_definition: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across all folds

model_configurations.SVM: Pipeline([('scaler', StandardScaler()), ('classifier', SVC(kernel='rbf', probability=True, random_state=42))]); scaler fit on each fold's training partition only
model_configurations.XGBoost: XGBClassifier(n_estimators=300, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.8, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, eval_metric='mlogloss'); trained on LabelEncoder-encoded labels, predictions decoded before scoring

notes: Cross-validation results estimate generalisation performance and are not directly interchangeable with the existing held-out 80:20 test results.
The held-out test score is not used as a cross-validation fold score.
All three models were evaluated on identical train/validation partitions.

Models are not ranked on any single fold; use mean and standard deviation across all folds. Repeats reuse the same samples, so folds are not fully independent and the standard deviation should be read descriptively.
Training times depend on hardware and system load.
